about_the_game:
You awaken in a shattered pod, surrounded by the toxic dust and howling monsters, thrust into a perilous underworld. Grow stronger through lightning-fast combat, diving deeper into the abyss to unravel its secrets. Collect hundreds of ancient relics, master over 50 unique skills, and forge your own legendary weapon from scavenged materials

Key Features

  • Unique downward-scrolling 2D platforming that breaks the mold of traditional side-scrollers

  • Highly polished, lightning-fast combat with responsive controls and exhilarating strike feedback

  • Unique switching between ranged gun and meele sword combat

  • Over 100 powerful relics left by TrailBlazers to collect and wield—each can enhance or reshape your playstyle, with rare relics completely transforming your adventure

  • 50+ distinct skills, each with unique flair and devastating impact

  • Endless combinations of relics and skills—experiment to craft your unique playstyle, from glass-cannon flair to unyielding tank builds

  • Craft unique weapons from gathered materials with custom power amplifying your skills and relics

  • Hand-drawn, story-rich art style that brings a vibrant underworld to life

  • An expansive world with rich story settings

  • Juicy loot-dropping chaos for a treasure-hunting thrill

Switch To Ranged Gun
Forge Your Weapon

Notice of localization

Since I only speak two languages, localization work will be done after the game is fully developed depend on my budget at that time. I plan to support as many languages as possible, but as this is a game made by me alone, with limited time and effort, all demos will use English uniformly. Thank you for your understanding  ʕง•ᴥ•ʔง

content_descriptors.notes: This is a 2D vertical platformer game where players control a Faceless being created in a laboratory, exploring an abandoned underground world. Along the way, players will encounter ferocious monsters and corrupted, distorted humans. Players will use a sword or gun to kill these enemies, who upon death will splatter large amounts of variously colored blood and often be dismembered into limbs of different sizes.

short_description: This is a unique hybrid of fast meele combat and ranged bullet hell shooter game. You will hack through monstrous hordes, craft your own unique weapons, and collect different relics and ammos . Uncover the TrailBlazers’ secrets, and rise as the Sanctuary’s hero to save all
